feeds.title: Rock Recipes
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Barry. I'm Dad to 2 amazing kids, author of 4 best-selling cookbooks, a freelance food writer & full time blogger. My lifetime love of cooking & baking has led me to share over 1800 recipes on this blog over the last 13 years. Come back often, there's always great new food & recipes coming out of my St. John's, Newfoundland kitchen!

feeds.title: Woman Scribbles
feeds.description: A website focusing on providing quality recipes for baking pastries, bread, and desserts. Get inspired to bake delicious bread and desserts and cook tasty and simple dishes with step-by-step photos, instructions, and videos.

feeds.title: Food Nouveau
feeds.description: Food Nouveau is a culinary website about the whys and hows of cooking and baking success. Written by award-winning author Marie Asselin.

feeds.title: Sweetopia
feeds.description: A blog mainly about decorated cookies, cupcakes, cakes, gingerbread houses, sugar art, sweets, tutorials, gifts, home decor and all things fun.

feeds.title: Food Meanderings
feeds.description: I'm Terri, a passionate home cook, and baker, My mission is to share not only my recipes, cooking hacks, and tips with you but also my secrets to successful weight maintenance. At Food Meanderings you'll find an easy, quick, shortcut, make-ahead, always delicious, and healthy and Weight Watchers-friendly recipes, with some indulgent baking thrown in for good measure!

feeds.title: Constellation Inspiration
feeds.description: Constellation Inspiration is a sweet, buttercream-coated journal that started in early 2015. I bake in my tiny little kitchen in Vancouver, BC. But inspiration stems from all over.Ultimately, this journal is a collection of recipes, stories, and love letters that are sweet to read, and even sweeter to eat.

feeds.title: Milk and Pop
feeds.description: I'm Tati, a coffee lover and self-taught baker that has been making bread and fresh recipes for over 15 years. Here at Milk and Pop, you'll find everything to make the first meal of your day unforgettable. Stay with me and let's have a tasty and uncomplicated breakfast in our pajamas.

feeds.title: Kelly Neil
feeds.description: Welcome to kellyneil.com! I'm Kelly, the photographer and voice behind this blog. This is where you'll find my favourite baking recipes, as well as the occasional savoury dish. I'm here to satisfy your craving for dessert, treats, and cozy comfort food!

feeds.title: The Bake School Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Janice. I am a baking-obsessed recipe developer with a Ph.D. in Chemistry who writes about baking and the science of baking. Get the best baking recipes, from simple chewy chocolate chip cookies to elaborate layer cakes. Learn about baking ingredients, the science of baking, and how to troubleshoot your baking recipes when something goes wrong.

feeds.title: Baked
feeds.description: Baked is a collaborative project brought to you by five Canadian women food bloggers. Our mission is to bring accessible baking recipes into your home kitchen with beautiful photography, lots of step-by-step images, and thorough, easy-to-read information. At Baked, there is something for everyone!

feeds.title: Lil Cupcake Monkey
feeds.description: Thank you for stopping by, I am Aroshaliny. Baby Mama to the Lil Cupcake Monkey, I started baking and blogging after he was born and hence the name. I have always loved photography since I started baking now it has turned mostly into food photography.

feeds.title: Ma Pies Blog
feeds.description: By learning skills from different chefs and sharing ideas, our goal is to help turn Calgary into a foodie city. We make frozen pies and deliver them to you so you can save time in the kitchen while preparing dinner and still enjoy a soft, flaky, and buttery crust.

feeds.title: Life Without Lemons
feeds.description: I am an Edmonton food blogger, lady butcher, enthusiastic baker, gin drinker, and lego picker upper. I make fabulous food and share it here.

feeds.title: I Am Not A Baker Blog
feeds.description: I am not a baker. These are my stories. I can't pinpoint the exact date. One day I was eating rugelach, the next I was making them. Before I knew it I really liked baking. I just didn't, and still don't know much about it. Hence, 'I Am Not A Baker'. It's for those of us who can, sort of.

feeds.title: A Canadian Foodie Blog » Baking
feeds.description: I am Valerie. I cook, bake, garden write and travel, buy local, eat seasonally, cook from scratch and cook at home!

feeds.title: Baking for friends
feeds.description: Learn easy baking recipes for your favorite desserts, cookies, main dish recipes, and more. Find the best baking tips and tricks at Baking for Friends.
